dedupe_keys.name: swifts space weather information and forecast services brin indonesia

description: SWIFtS is the space weather information and forecast service of the Center for Space Research at the Indonesian National Research and Innovation Agency (BRIN). It publishes a daily summary and a 24-hour forecast of solar eruptive activity, geomagnetic activity and ionospheric conditions (the forecast read was issued on 26 September 2026 at 08:00 UTC), and essential information for user communities on HF radio communication (maximum usable frequency depression and shortwave fadeout or radio blackout), navigation (positioning errors) and satellites (high-energy protons and electrons), followed by detailed information on solar activity such as flares. Access is free and public online; no licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: the service is a bulletin and dashboard, not a documented data archive. Coverage is Indonesia, with global solar context. It supports hazard exposure and emergency response planning for space weather effects on HF communications, GNSS and satellites; related records are the NICT space weather forecast, the IIG equatorial electrojet model and SCiESMEX.
